question: Qual è il premio mensile più basso dell'assicurazione di base per un adulto di 30 anni domiciliato a Lugano con franchigia di 2500 franchi?
reference_answer: For 2026, the cheapest mandatory basic insurance premium in Lugano (premium region TI 1, adult, deductible CHF 2,500) is CHF 449.90 per month without accident cover, or CHF 473.60 with accident cover (alternative insurance model). The cheapest standard model is CHF 523.20 without accident cover. Source: BAG premium data.

Uses 2025 premiums
Does not say whether accident cover is included

question: Wie hoch ist der normale Mehrwertsteuersatz in der Schweiz?
reference_answer: 8.1 % (Normalsatz), in force since 1 January 2024. Reduced rate 2.6 %, accommodation 3.8 %. Parliament has approved a rise to 8.5 % to part-finance the 13th AHV pension, but it is subject to the vote of 29 November 2026 and would not take effect before 2028.

Presents the proposed 8.5 % as current

question: Mein Vermieter erhöht die Miete wegen des Referenzzinssatzes. Wie lange habe ich Zeit, die Erhöhung anzufechten?
reference_answer: 30 days from notification, at the locally competent conciliation authority for rental matters (Art. 270b OR).

question: Wann wird bei uns das nächste Mal Karton abgeholt?
reference_answer: Ask which municipality (and, if the calendar is street-based, which area or street). Collection dates are set by each municipality.

question: Ich ziehe als Schweizerin in die Stadt Bern. Bis wann muss ich mich anmelden, und wie?
reference_answer: Within 14 days, via the eUmzugCH portal (otherwise with the form and attachments), at the Einwohnerdienste, Migration und Fremdenpolizei of the City of Bern, Predigergasse 5.
common_errors: Gives the German 2-week rule for Anmeldung in Germany
Asks for the municipality although Bern was given
evidence: Anmeldung Zuzug als Schweizerin oder Schweizer ... Melden Sie sich bitte innert 14 Tagen über das Portal eUmzugCH an.

question: Je déménage à Saint-Gall. Dans quel délai dois-je annoncer mon arrivée, et qu'est-ce que je risque si je suis en retard ?
reference_answer: Within 14 days of moving in (online via eUmzugCH or at the counter with an official ID). A late report can be fined up to CHF 200 (Art. 6 of the St. Gallen law on residence, sGS 453.1).
common_errors: Uses another canton's rules
Says there is no penalty
evidence: Gemäss Art. 6 vom Gesetz über Niederlassung und Aufenthalt (sGS 453.1) beträgt die Meldepflicht 14 Tage ab Datum Ihres Zuzuges. Erfolgt die Meldung später als 14 Tage, kann dies mit einer Busse von bis zu Fr. 200.00 geahndet werden.

question: Wie viel kostet die Anmeldung bei der Gemeinde, wenn ich umziehe?
reference_answer: Ask for the municipality. Fees are set by each municipality: for example Winterthur charges CHF 40 for registration, while other municipalities charge differently.
common_errors: Gives one city's fee as if it applied everywhere
evidence: Winterthur: Die Anmeldung kostet 40 CHF. Die Abmeldung ist kostenlos.

question: Dopo quanti anni in Svizzera posso chiedere la naturalizzazione ordinaria?
reference_answer: After 10 years of residence in Switzerland in total, 3 of them in the 5 years before applying, and with a settlement permit (C). Years between ages 8 and 18 count double, but actual residence must be at least 6 years. Cantons add 2 to 5 years of residence in the canton and municipality (Art. 9 BüG).
common_errors: Gives an older or a foreign residence requirement
Omits the settlement permit (C) condition
evidence: Wenn ich 10 Jahre Wohnsitz in der Schweiz habe, wovon drei in den letzten fünf Jahren vor Einreichung des Gesuchs, und über eine Niederlassungsbewilligung (Bewilligung C) verfüge. Die Zeit zwischen dem vollendeten 8. und 18. Altersjahr wird doppelt gezählt. Bei Doppelzählung hat der tatsächliche Aufenthalt jedoch mindestens 6 Jahre zu betragen (Art. 9 BüG).

question: Wie hoch ist die maximale AHV-Altersrente pro Monat im Jahr 2026?
reference_answer: CHF 2,520 per month (full contribution period); the minimum is CHF 1,260. A married couple's two pensions together are capped at CHF 3,780. From 2026 there is also a 13th old-age pension, paid for the first time in December 2026.
common_errors: Gives the amount of an earlier year
Gives a German pension figure
evidence: Beträge gültig ab dem 1. Januar 2026 ... AHV-Renten (pro Monat, 13 Auszahlungen*) Minimale Altersrente 1'260 Fr. Maximale Altersrente 2'520 Fr. Maximaler Betrag der addierten individuellen Renten eines Ehepaars 3'780 Fr.

question: Quand la 13e rente AVS sera-t-elle versée pour la première fois ?
reference_answer: In December 2026, as a supplement to the December pension. It equals one twelfth of the old-age pensions paid during the year. Survivors' pensions, child pensions and disability pensions do not get a 13th payment.
common_errors: Says it was already paid in 2025
Says it is paid monthly
evidence: Die 13. AHV-Rente wird im Dezember 2026 erstmals ausbezahlt. Sie entspricht einem Zwölftel der Summe der während des Jahres ausgerichteten Altersrenten.

question: Quanto deve pagare come minimo di contributi AVS/AI/IPG una persona senza attività lucrativa?
reference_answer: At least CHF 530 per year (AHV CHF 435, IV CHF 70, EO CHF 25). The maximum is 50 times the minimum.
common_errors: Gives the contribution rate for employees instead of the minimum amount
evidence: Stand 1. Januar 2026 ... Nichterwerbstätige entrichten einen AHV/IV/EO-Beitrag von mindestens CHF 530 (AHV: CHF 435; IV: CHF 70; EO: CHF 25). Der Maximalbeitrag entspricht dem 50-fachen Mindestbeitrag.

question: Ich habe die Kündigung bekommen. Bis wann muss ich mich beim RAV anmelden?
reference_answer: As early as possible, ideally during the notice period, and at the latest on the first day for which you claim unemployment benefits. Registration is online (Job-Room eService) or in person at the RAV; benefits cannot be claimed retroactively.

must_include.fact: at the latest on the first day

common_errors: Applies the German Agentur für Arbeit rules
Says registration can be done afterwards
evidence: Wenn Sie von Arbeitslosigkeit betroffen oder bedroht sind, melden Sie sich so früh wie möglich beim RAV für die öffentlichen Arbeitsvermittlung an. Sie müssen sich spätestens am ersten Tag anmelden, für den Sie Leistungen der Arbeitslosenversicherung beanspruchen.

question: Comment puis-je échanger mon permis de conduire étranger contre un permis suisse dans le canton de Vaud, et combien de temps ai-je pour le faire?
reference_answer: You have 12 months from arrival in Switzerland. Fill in form 220 ('Demande d'un permis de conduire suisse sur la base d'un permis de conduire étranger'), gather the documents it lists, and submit the complete file to the Service des automobiles et de la navigation (SAN). A control drive may be required depending on the issuing country, or after 5 years in Switzerland without regular driving. After 12 months you may no longer drive on the foreign licence.

Omits the cantonal office
authority: Canton of Vaud, Service des automobiles et de la navigation (SAN)
evidence: Si vous êtes titulaire d'un permis de conduire étranger valable et que vous vous installez en Suisse, vous disposez d'un délai de 12 mois dès votre arrivée pour échanger votre permis étranger contre un document suisse. [vd.ch/prestation/echanger-un-permis-de-conduire-etranger:] Déposez votre dossier complet au Service des automobiles et de la navigation (SAN).

reference_answer: CHF 40, as sticker or e-vignette. It is valid from 1 December 2025 to 31 January 2027. The e-vignette should be bought only in the official BAZG shop (e-vignette.ch / via.admin.ch).

question: Qual è il tasso ipotecario di riferimento attualmente in vigore per gli affitti in Svizzera?
reference_answer: 1.25 %, in force since 2 September 2025 and confirmed unchanged on 2 September 2026. Published by the Federal Office for Housing (BWO); next publication 1 December 2026.

question: Wenn der Referenzzinssatz um 0,25 Prozentpunkte steigt, um wie viel darf meine Miete steigen?
reference_answer: By up to 3 % (Art. 13 para. 1 let. c VMWG). A 0.25-point fall gives the tenant a claim to a reduction of 2.91 %. Other cost factors can also apply, so the actual change depends on the contract.
common_errors: Says the rent rises by 0.25 %
Confuses the reference rate with the SNB policy rate
evidence: Falls der Referenzzinssatz um 0,25 Prozentpunkte steigt, kann der Mietzins um 3 Prozent erhöht werden (vgl. Art. 13 Abs. 1 lit. c VMWG).

question: Welcher Referenzzinssatz gilt für meine Mietwohnung in Zürich?
reference_answer: The national reference rate applies everywhere in Switzerland: 1.25 %, in force since 2 September 2025. There is no cantonal rate, so no need to ask for more detail.

common_errors: Asks for the canton

question: Quante firme servono per un'iniziativa popolare federale e in quanto tempo vanno raccolte?
reference_answer: 100,000 valid signatures of Swiss voters, collected within 18 months of the initiative text being published in the Federal Gazette. The Federal Chancellery counts them and declares whether the initiative has succeeded.

Confuses the popular initiative with the optional referendum
evidence: Sind innerhalb von 18 Monaten 100 000 gültige Unterschriften zusammengekommen, so erklärt die Bundeskanzlei, dass die Volksinitiative zustande gekommen ist.

question: Worüber wird am 27. September 2026 eidgenössisch abgestimmt?
reference_answer: Two popular initiatives: the Neutralitätsinitiative ('Wahrung der schweizerischen Neutralität') and the Ernährungsinitiative ('Für eine sichere Ernährung ...').

Invents proposals

question: À partir de quel chiffre d'affaires une entreprise doit-elle s'inscrire à la TVA en Suisse ?
reference_answer: From CHF 100,000 of annual turnover (in Switzerland and abroad) from supplies that are not exempt. For non-profit, volunteer-run sports and cultural associations and charitable organisations the threshold is CHF 250,000 (Art. 10 para. 2 MWSTG).
common_errors: Gives the French franchise en base thresholds in euros
Says every company must register

question: Ich kaufe in Konstanz ein und bringe Waren für 200 Franken in die Schweiz zurück. Muss ich Mehrwertsteuer bezahlen?
reference_answer: Yes. Since 1 January 2025 the VAT-free allowance is CHF 150 per person per day (it was CHF 300). Above that, Swiss VAT is due on the whole value, here CHF 200, not only on the part above CHF 150. This is a Swiss question even though the shop is in Germany.
common_errors: Uses the old CHF 300 allowance
Says VAT is due only on CHF 50
Treats it as a German question because of Konstanz
authority: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (BAZG)
evidence: Übersteigt der Gesamtwert 150 Franken, so müssen Sie für den Gesamtwert der eingeführten Waren die Mehrwertsteuer bezahlen. Beispiel: Der Gesamtwert beträgt 400 Franken. Die 150 Franken sind überschritten. Somit wird die Mehrwertsteuer auf 400 Franken berechnet.

question: Fino a quale valore posso portare in Svizzera merci comprate all'estero senza pagare l'IVA?
reference_answer: CHF 150 per person per day, since 1 January 2025 (previously CHF 300), for goods for private use or as gifts. A single item worth more than CHF 150 is always subject to VAT.
common_errors: Gives the old CHF 300 allowance
Gives the Italian or EU travel allowance in euros
authority: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (BAZG)
evidence: Demnach wird die Wertfreigrenze im Reiseverkehr ab dem 1. Januar 2025 von 300 Franken auf 150 Franken pro Person und Tag gesenkt.

question: Wie viele Menschen lebten Ende 2025 in der Schweiz?
reference_answer: 9,127,100 people in the permanent resident population on 31 December 2025 (definitive BFS figure published 20 August 2026; the provisional figure in April was 9,124,300). Growth +0.8 % on 2024.
common_errors: Gives the 2024 figure (9,051,000)
Gives a UN estimate instead of the BFS figure
evidence: Am 31. Dezember 2025 umfasste die ständige Wohnbevölkerung der Schweiz 9 127 100 Personen. Das sind 0,8% mehr als 2024.

question: Combien coûte la redevance radio-télévision pour un ménage privé en Suisse ?
reference_answer: CHF 335 per year per private household, collected by Serafe AG. The Federal Council has decided to lower it to CHF 312 in 2027 and CHF 300 from 2029.

Gives the planned 2029 amount of CHF 300 as current

question: Wie hoch ist der Rundfunkbeitrag, den ich nach meinem Umzug nach Konstanz zahlen muss?
reference_answer: Konstanz is in Germany, so this is not a Swiss question. The German Rundfunkbeitrag applies there; a Swiss source cannot answer it, and the Swiss household levy (CHF 335, Serafe) does not apply.

question: Wo finde ich den offiziellen Schweizer Fahrplandatensatz 2026, und welchen Zeitraum deckt er ab?
reference_answer: The official 2026 Swiss public transport timetable dataset is published on opentransportdata.swiss in GTFS format. It covers 14 December 2025 through 12 December 2026. The dataset is published by the SKI business office on behalf of the Federal Office of Transport (FOT).
common_errors: Uses a foreign timetable source
Presents the 2026 dataset as covering the whole calendar year
Confuses the timetable data with real-time updates
authority: Customer Information System Tasks (SKI) business office, on behalf of the Federal Office of Transport (FOT)
evidence: Temporal coverage: December 14, 2025 - December 12, 2026. The timetable is provided in the General Transit Feed Specification Format (GTFS). Working on behalf of the Swiss Federal Office of Transport (FOT), the Customer Information System Tasks (SKI) business office publishes data on all public transport in Switzerland.
verified_by: Codex research against the official dataset page

question: Les données GTFS statiques des transports publics suisses indiquent-elles les retards en temps réel ?
reference_answer: No. GTFS Static describes planned timetable data and does not provide real-time information such as delays. opentransportdata.swiss provides GTFS Realtime separately for real-time information.

must_include.fact: GTFS Static is planned/static timetable data

must_not_include.reason: Incorrectly claims static GTFS includes real-time delays

common_errors: Says the static feed contains live delays
Treats service alerts and timetable schedules as the same data
Claims the Swiss dataset has no real-time data at all
authority: Customer Information System Tasks (SKI) business office / opentransportdata.swiss
evidence: A GTFS static file contains all public transport in Switzerland in a public transport timetable year (365 days from mid-December). Unlike GTFS Realtime (GTFS-RT), GTFS Static provides only static data, not real-time data.
verified_by: Codex research against the official GTFS documentation

question: Con quale frequenza viene aggiornato il dataset ufficiale dell'orario svizzero 2026 su opentransportdata.swiss?

evidence: Update interval: Two times a week. Please note: There will be no updates on public holidays (e.g. Easter Monday, Whit Monday, etc.).
